purpose: Per-deposit external-metadata sidecar for a fresh alexanarch deposit. Contains OpenAlex work IDs for the deposit itself and for its cited works; Wikidata QIDs for external entities named in the deposit; DataCite severance status for cited DOIs. Complements the registry.json entry, which holds the core concepts/citations/entities. Generated by enrich_deposit.py.

sidecars.note: This developmental-version deposit is superseded by AXN:0458 (deposit #1095), the source-engaged revision composed under the standing rule that engagement with sources is composition-primary in formal academic works. Per container spec §3.7 stratification: this address remains the valid name of its byte-state (non-destruction); citations to AXN:0457 remain accurate for what these bytes said. The successor mint's changes are localized to §§II, III, and References; §§I, IV-VIII, and appendices hash identically across versions.
